verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a productivity and collaboration suite, since competing suites can be deployed on-premises, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Google Workspace. The cited material covers only cloud admin APIs, SSO, device management and hosted features, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
